title: [main] Bug 649204 Validation missing for Deferral Code field on Released Purchase documents.
summary: Deferral Code field on released purchase line documents now validates that the purchase header status is open, preventing modification of deferrals on non-open purchase records.
key_points: Added missing validation for Deferral Code field on purchase lines
Validation ensures purchase header status must be 'Open' before allowing deferral code changes
Applied across all localization layers and base application
Includes test automation to verify the validation works correctly
quote: Status must be equal to 'Open' in Purchase Header validation missing for Deferral Code field on Released Purchase documents.
